name: Brand
definition: Nominal typing for a validated primitive.

name: Result
definition: Accepted value or named refusal; the only way a context reports a refusal.

name: Accepted
definition: The accepted half of a Result.

name: Refused
definition: The refused half of a Result, carrying the refusal.

name: FileSystem
definition: Port: the reads a consumer may ask of the file system, by URL: one file's bytes, one folder's entries, or a folder's whole tree. Consumers declare narrower ports from it.

name: FileSystemFault
definition: Why the file system could not read something: not found, permission denied, not a file, or failed.

name: FileSystemError
definition: A read the file system refused, with its fault.

name: FolderEntry
definition: One entry of a listed folder: its name and whether it is a file, a folder, or something else.

name: TreeFile
definition: One file read from a tree: its SourcePath within the folder read and its bytes.

name: UnreadableTreeFile
definition: One entry of a tree that could not be read, named by its raw path within the folder, with its fault or an unportable name.

name: TreeReading
definition: A folder's whole tree: every file read, sorted by path, and every entry that could not be read.

name: NodeFileLib
definition: The Node file calls the file-system implementer wraps; its own test fakes them.

name: ReadFileArgs
definition: The file a FileSystem read names, by URL.

name: ListFolderArgs
definition: The folder a FileSystem listing names, by URL.

name: ReadTreeArgs
definition: The folder a FileSystem tree read starts from, by URL, and the consumer's TreeSelection of which entries to read.

name: CreateNodeFileSystemArgs
definition: The optional NodeFileLib seam the Node file-system implementer is built with.

name: FileWriteError
definition: A write the file system refused, with its fault.

name: MakeScratchFolderArgs
definition: The parent folder a private scratch folder is made below, by URL.

name: MakeFolderArgs
definition: The folder to make, with any missing parents, by URL.

name: WriteFileArgs
definition: The file to write, by URL, and its content; missing parent folders are made.

name: RemoveFolderArgs
definition: The folder to remove with everything below it, by URL.

name: ProcessRunner
definition: Port: runs the current runtime as a child process and returns how it ended and what it wrote.

name: ProcessArgument
definition: One argument or environment value for a child process: text, a path given by URL, or the runtime's own folder.

name: RunCurrentRuntimeArgs
definition: A child run of the current runtime: its arguments, its whole environment, its working folder and its input.

name: ProcessExit
definition: How a child process ended: exited with a code, or ended by a signal.

name: ProcessOutput
definition: A finished child process: how it ended and its output and error text.

name: ProcessFailure
definition: Why a child process could not be started.

name: NativeProcessRequest
definition: A child run with every path rendered natively, as the process library seam receives it.

name: NativeProcessExit
definition: What the process library seam reports about a finished child.

name: NodeProcessLib
definition: The runtime calls the process-runner implementer wraps; its own test fakes them.

name: CreateNodeProcessRunnerArgs
definition: The optional NodeProcessLib seam the process-runner implementer is built with.

name: YamlParser
definition: Port: parses YAML text into an unknown value for a Zod schema to decode, or refuses it.

name: ParseYamlArgs
definition: The YAML text to parse.

name: YamlRefusal
definition: Why text could not be parsed as YAML.

name: BunYamlLib
definition: The runtime YAML call the YAML-parser implementer wraps; its own test fakes it.

name: CreateBunYamlParserArgs
definition: The optional BunYamlLib seam the YAML-parser implementer is built with.

name: TreeEntry
definition: One entry a tree read meets: its raw path within the folder read and whether it is a file, a folder or something else.

name: TreeSelection
definition: The consumer's rule for a tree read: read or skip each entry before it is read, descended into or reported.

name: NonEmptyArray
definition: A readonly list with at least one item.

name: ContentHash
definition: sha256 of a file's bytes, written sha256:<hex>.

name: FrameworkVersion
definition: An AI-DLC release version, stable or preview.

name: DistributionId
definition: The id of one harness distribution (claude, kiro-ide, codex...); open set, registered once.

name: Timestamp
definition: A UTC ISO-8601 instant.

name: KernelRefusal
definition: Why a raw value is not a valid kernel identity or path.

name: StageSlug
definition: Identity of a Stage; kebab-case and equal to its file stem.

name: ScopeName
definition: Identity of a Scope; one shell-safe word.

name: AgentSlug
definition: Identity of an Agent persona.

name: ArtifactName
definition: Identity of an artifact in the method's vocabulary.

name: SensorId
definition: Identity of a SensorDeclaration.

name: PluginId
definition: Identity of a plugin; never core, aidlc, or a name in core's aidlc- namespace, which are reserved for AI-DLC.

name: Owner
definition: Who authored a definition: core, a plugin, or the project (a saved scope).

name: DefinitionIdentity
definition: Which Workflow Definition identity a raw value was meant to be.

name: IdentityRefusal
definition: Why a method identity was refused: malformed, or a plugin name reserved for AI-DLC.

name: Phase
definition: One of initialization, ideation, inception, construction, operation.

name: UnitKind
definition: What a Unit of work is (service, spec, ui, packaging, library); prunes per-unit artifacts.

name: Tier
definition: How much judgment an agent's work needs: judgment, balanced, templated.

name: ReviewClass
definition: How a review runs: none, advisory, adversarial.

name: GuardPolicy
definition: How far the switchable guards stand aside: strict, relaxed, off.

name: CeremonyKey
definition: A per-work ceremony a scope can switch: sensors, learnings, summary confirmation, plan approval, collaborators.

name: CeremonySwitch
definition: On or off, as the person says it.

name: CeremonyDefaults
definition: The ceremony switches a scope sets; unset ones stay on.

name: Depth
definition: How deep a scope runs: minimal, standard, comprehensive.

name: ProjectType
definition: Brownfield or greenfield.

name: CollaborationMode
definition: Who talks to whom while a stage runs: inline, subagent, pipeline, mob, agent-team.

name: EnsembleMode
definition: A CollaborationMode that needs support agents: pipeline or mob.

name: SoloCapableMode
definition: A CollaborationMode that can run with the lead alone.

name: AgentRef
definition: A stage lead: the conductor itself or a named Agent.

name: Participation
definition: A stage's lead, supports and mode; ensemble modes require supports by type.

name: StageExecution
definition: Whether a stage always runs or runs on its stated condition.

name: StageCardinality
definition: Whether a stage runs once or once per Unit.

name: ArtifactProduction
definition: An artifact a stage writes, required or optional, for which unit kinds.

name: ArtifactConsumption
definition: An artifact a stage reads, whether required, when, and whether its deliverables cite it.

name: ReviewPolicy
definition: A stage's reviewer, reviewed artifact, iteration cap and declared class.

name: SummaryConfirmation
definition: Whether a stage owes the person a consolidated-summary confirmation.

name: StageActivation
definition: A structured predicate that switches a stage on (producer-in-plan).

name: ComposerTarget
definition: An outcome component the composer screens a stage for.

name: ComposerRole
definition: A stage's structural role in composer screening.

name: ComposerPrior
definition: The composer's screening prior for a stage: targets, cost, role, project types.

name: StageBriefing
definition: A stage's stated inputs and outputs, and its instructions as an AuthoredBody.

name: Stage
definition: One station of the method: what it produces and consumes, who works it, how it is reviewed.

name: ToolPolicy
definition: Which host tools an agent may not use.

name: Agent
definition: A persona that works stations: identity, model, tools, persona body and additions.

name: Scope
definition: A production line: depth, Guard Policy, ceremony and review defaults.

name: RuleLayer
definition: Where a rule sits: org, team, project or a phase.

name: RulePairing
definition: Whether a rule is checked by a sensor, feedforward only, or unpaired.

name: Rule
definition: One rule file at its layer: identity, source, owner, pairing and text.

name: SensorSeverity
definition: Advisory or blocking.

name: SensorTrigger
definition: When a sensor fires: on write or at the gate.

name: SensorFieldShape
definition: One sensor field: a value type as authored, or a list of objects with their own fields.

name: SensorFieldShapes
definition: Declared input or output fields of a sensor, nested losslessly.

name: SensorDeclaration
definition: A deterministic check a stage can pull in: command, severity, trigger, path filter.

name: KnowledgeAudience
definition: Whether a knowledge document is shared or for one agent.

name: KnowledgeDocument
definition: One knowledge file's method source path, owner and audience; its bytes are in MethodSources.files.

name: SharedKnowledge
definition: The Method's knowledge documents a dispatched agent may preload, with the shipped format documents that are left out of them.

name: OverlayAnchor
definition: Any overlay anchor, stage or persona.

name: OverlayFragment
definition: One overlay text at an anchor, with its order.

name: OverlayDropReason
definition: Why an overlay was not applied.

name: MethodFinding
definition: An advisory fact from compiling the method, such as a dropped overlay; never a refusal.

name: StageAdditions
definition: Artifacts and sections a plugin adds to an existing stage.

name: OverlayTarget
definition: Whether an overlay targets a stage or an agent.

name: Overlay
definition: A plugin's additive change to a core stage or persona.

name: ContributionDependency
definition: What a plugin needs present: core or another plugin.

name: Contribution
definition: One installed plugin: version, dependencies, rule level, content, overlays and tools.

name: ContributedContent
definition: Authored content core or a plugin may contribute: stages, scopes, memberships, freeform default claims, agents, rules, sensors and knowledge.

name: CoreContent
definition: Core's authored content: contributed content plus the core hooks. Plugins contribute no hooks, matching upstream.

name: PluginSelection
definition: Which owners compile into the method: every installed, or core on or off plus listed plugins; initialization always runs.

name: Method
definition: The compiled method; only CompileMethod produces one.

name: StageNumber
definition: A stage's compiled display number, <phase>.<index>.

name: StageNode
definition: One compiled stage: number, availability, rules in context and active sensors.

name: ScopeColumn
definition: A scope's stages: initialization stages always, then its enabled members.

name: StageGraph
definition: The compiled stage nodes; scope columns are derived from memberships.

name: GraphEntry
definition: A stage node of the compiled graph paired with its Stage; the Method guarantees every node names one of its stages.

name: DefinitionConcept
definition: Which method concept a MethodRefusal is about.

name: MethodRefusal
definition: Why authored content or a contribution cannot join the method.

name: MethodReading
definition: The async result of reading authored method content.

name: PluginSelectionSource
definition: Port: reads which plugins this install has switched on.

name: CompileMethodRequest
definition: Core content, contributions, saved scopes, pins and selection to compile.

name: CompileMethod
definition: Use case: compiles content and contributions into a Method or refuses with reasons.

name: LoadMethod
definition: Use case: reads the authored method sources and compiles them.

name: AuthoredMethodLoading
definition: Use cases Workflow Definition's root composes for a build: load the core method from its authored folder, and load the plugins against an already loaded core.

name: PluginBuildRequest
definition: The loaded core method and the folder the authored plugins are read from.

name: HostShell
definition: Port: which installed distribution the host shell marks, if any.

name: CliFirstSetup
definition: The setup step and first-run lines a tree two hosts run says when the person runs its CLI rather than its editor.

name: HostListing
definition: How a host appears in the harness lists and the first-run wizard: its choice name and note, its first-run steps, its editor terminal and its CLI-first setup.

name: NativeReplacement
definition: A text a host's native release replaces in its projected tree, and what replaces it.

name: NativeRelease
definition: What a host's native release changes in the copy tree: its text replacements, the files only a copy ships, and whether its onboarding names the exact read-only commands the native allow list carries.

name: HostPluginTarget
definition: Where a host's plugins land: the plugin format the shipped plugin emitter knows it by, manifest and marketplace folders, whether a marketplace catalogue is written for it, and the project roots a plugin may write.

name: HostDistribution
definition: What a host decides about how it ships: its layout, the earlier shapes of its root files, its listing, its native release and its plugin target.

name: Sharing
definition: Whether a root file is exclusive, a union of harnesses, or identical across them.

name: RootIntegration
definition: A project-root file a harness shares with the person and the policy for merging it.

name: RootIntegrationPolicy
definition: managed-block, whole-file, json-map, json-array, jsonc-settings or json-entries.

name: FileContent
definition: A file's exact content, as text or as bytes.

name: RenderedConcept
definition: Which method or harness concept a rendered file came from. orchestrator-skill is the one door and its fixed entry shortcuts into it, /aidlc-init and /aidlc-compose, which add no second entry point. host-data is a runtime data file whose content the host decides, such as tools/data/harness.json and tools/data/plugin-agent.md; data that is the same for every host is not host-data.

name: RuntimeDataName
definition: The host-neutral runtime data the build renders rather than copies: the agent tiers and the settings schema, each placed under a host's tools/data folder.

name: ProjectionOrigin
definition: Where a projected file came from: a method source, a neutral core file (protocols, templates, session skills, the SharedRuntime copies), the harness, a render, or a RuntimeDataName.

name: DistributionChannel
definition: Which channel a projection is rendered for: the copy that runs from the project folder, or the native release that runs the installed aidlc command.

name: Availability
definition: Whether a projected file ships always or on one DistributionChannel only.

name: ProjectedFile
definition: One harness-correct file with its origin.

name: HookPoint
definition: A host lifecycle point a hook attaches to: a lifecycle point or a tool point.

name: NeutralDocumentRole
definition: What a core document a host places is: a protocol, a template, the conductor, a stage or a knowledge document.

name: NeutralDocument
definition: A core document a host places into its tree with its tokens bound, its rules folder renamed and, for a protocol, only its own binding subsection kept.

name: AuthoredHostFile
definition: A file a harness authors for its own tree, placed by that harness with its own path and mode.

name: DirectoryOwnership
definition: Whether AI-DLC owns a whole directory or only the files it shipped there.

name: ManagedDirectory
definition: A directory a host declares AI-DLC manages, and how; the most specific declaration wins.

name: SessionSkill
definition: A read-only session skill and every file under its folder, sidecars and binary bytes included, each at its SourcePath below the core root (skills/<name>/...).

name: OnboardingTemplates
definition: The neutral onboarding text and the per-harness skeleton.

name: NeutralSurface
definition: Non-method material a harness places: protocols, templates, session skills, onboarding.

name: RuntimeFile
definition: One file read from the core tools, hooks, sensors or scopes folder: its source path and its bytes.

name: SharedRuntime
definition: The runtime bytes that are the same for every host, captured once per build: the core tools, hooks, sensors and scopes files except the version module, the version module as stamped for this build, and the agent-tiers and settings-schema data.

name: ProjectionFinding
definition: An advisory fact found while projecting.

name: ProjectionRefusal
definition: Why a harness cannot project: unknown, colliding paths, a render failure for one subject, a command source that failed as a whole, before any subject, a host's authored source file that could not be read, or a core neutral source file that could not be read.

name: Projection
definition: One host's projected files and findings.

name: Rendering
definition: Files a Harness rendered, or why it could not.

name: Harness
definition: Port: one harness's host-bound token bindings and renderings; Projection binds HARNESS_DIR from the host's directory.

name: HarnessRegistry
definition: Port: the registered Harness adapters, found by DistributionId.

name: NeutralSurfaceReader
definition: Port: reads the NeutralSurface from core.

name: SessionSkillSource
definition: Port: reads only the session skills from core, for a caller that needs no documents or onboarding.

name: SessionSkillTreeReader
definition: Port: reads the core session skills folder as one tree of bytes, naming each entry it cannot read; the file-system implementer serves it.

name: HostFileReader
definition: Port: reads one authored host file as bytes, or says why it cannot; the file-system implementer serves it.

name: BuildProjection
definition: Use cases Projection's root composes for a build: serialize a compiled method for a host, read a host's authored sources, and prepare the frozen command runners' source.

name: CompiledMethodRequest
definition: The method, the host and where its memory sits, for serializing the compiled method a host ships.

name: HostSourceCapture
definition: Which authored files to read for a host: the folder they live in, the files to read, and the ones that must exist.

name: CommandSourceRequest
definition: What the frozen command runners need for one host: the method, its source files, the project root they write into, and the host directory and name.

name: SessionSkillCapture
definition: Where the session skills are read from: the folder that holds them and the source path their files are named under.

name: SessionSkillReading
definition: The BuildProjection member that reads every session skill in a SessionSkillCapture, or says which files it could not read.

name: SkillProjectionRequest
definition: What Projection needs to render one host's skills: the Method, the host's identity, the built tree whose skill-table tool renders the tables, the host's HostSkillRenderer, the authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, the command source and placement, and the session skills read for the build.

name: SkillProjection
definition: The BuildProjection member that renders a host's orchestrator skill, its command shortcuts and its session skills from a SkillProjectionRequest, running the built tree's skill-table tool for the tables.

name: SettingsProjectionRequest
definition: What Projection needs to render one host's settings and hook registrations: the Method, the host's identity and HostSettingsRenderer, the authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, the DistributionChannel and the runtime entrypoints the install ships.

name: SettingsProjection
definition: The BuildProjection member that renders one host's settings and hook registrations from a SettingsProjectionRequest, reading the CopyChannelAllows through the registered dispatcher bridge.

name: VersionStamp
definition: Stamps the version module with this build's release version, or says why it cannot; the build root wires it from Packaging.

name: RuntimeCapture
definition: What Projection reads the SharedRuntime from: the core folder, the Method the data files are rendered from, and the VersionStamp.

name: RuntimeReading
definition: The BuildProjection member that reads the SharedRuntime from a RuntimeCapture, or says which files it could not read.

name: RuntimeProjectionRequest
definition: What Projection needs to place the SharedRuntime for one host: the host's identity, the SharedRuntime and the token bindings.

name: RuntimeProjection
definition: The BuildProjection member that places the SharedRuntime under one host's directory with its tokens applied.

name: AgentProjectionRequest
definition: What Projection needs to render one host's agents: the Method, the host's HostAgentRenderer, the captured host identity, the DistributionChannel, the authored files and their preparer, and the tier cap the build runs under.

name: AgentProjection
definition: The BuildProjection member that renders every Method agent and the conductor agent of one host from an AgentProjectionRequest, serving the AgentModelPolicy through the model-policy bridge.

name: HostSurfaceProjectionRequest
definition: What Projection needs to render one host's surface: the host's identity, its HostData and authored placements, the captured authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, and the DistributionChannel.

name: HostSurfaceProjection
definition: The BuildProjection member that renders a host's harness.json and plugin-agent frontmatter, and places each captured file its authored placements name, from a HostSurfaceProjectionRequest.

name: LegacyRunnerScratch
definition: Port: makes, fills and removes the private scratch folder the legacy runner bridge works in; the file-system implementer serves it.

name: LegacyRunnerProcess
definition: Port: runs the legacy runner bridge's child on the current runtime; the process-runner implementer serves it.

name: SkillTableVerb
definition: Which generated table a skill region holds: the compiled stage graph or the compiled scope grid.

name: SkillTableRenderer
definition: Renders the generated table for one skill region, or says why it could not.

name: AuthoredFilePreparer
definition: Prepares one authored host file the way the build's single host-source read does before a renderer uses it.

name: SkillRenderingInputs
definition: What every host's skill renderer gets from the build root: the authored orchestrator files, their preparer, the token bindings and the skill-table renderer.

name: HostSkillRenderer
definition: One host's factory for its orchestrator-skill and session-skill Harness members, built from the SkillRenderingInputs.

name: CopyChannelAllows
definition: What a copy-channel install pre-approves: the dispatcher's public commands outside its engine namespace and AI-DLC's tool scripts that never reach the machine.

name: CopyChannelAllowSource
definition: Port: reads the CopyChannelAllows from the shipped dispatcher's owner; the legacy dispatcher bridge serves it until that owner moves into src.

name: SettingsRenderingInputs
definition: What every host's settings and hooks renderer gets from the build root: the authored settings and hook files, their preparer, the token bindings, the CopyChannelAllows, the runtime entrypoints the install ships, and the DistributionChannel it renders for.

name: HostSettingsRenderer
definition: One host's factory for its settings and hook-registration Harness members, built from the SettingsRenderingInputs.

name: HookActivation
definition: What a host whose hooks wait on the person tells them: the recovery step, and the lines for a missed reply, hooks not run yet and the agent's own step.

name: StatusLine
definition: How AI-DLC shows its progress in a host's status line: a command the host runs, or the items it lists.

name: NewChatStep
definition: The person's step to a clean chat in a host, as a host's data records it: the line to show, and the line for when the agent's shell runs inside the host, named by its environment variables.

name: DocumentExtractorSpec
definition: A command a host runs to turn a document into text, with its time limit.

name: KiroLayout
definition: Which Kiro agent layout a Kiro tree runs: the version-one agents or the agent system.

name: HostData
definition: What a host decides about its own runtime data: its product name, the step after config, its rules folder and every host-specific line the engine reads from harness.json, plus the plugin agent frontmatter.

name: AuthoredPlacement
definition: Where a host places one of its authored files: its source under the host's folder and its project-relative destination.

name: OnboardingFills
definition: A host's fills for the onboarding skeleton: the invoke command it names and the markdown for each slot.

name: DocumentRenderingInputs
definition: What every host's onboarding and documents renderer gets from the build root: its onboarding fills and the token bindings.

name: HostDocumentRenderer
definition: One host's factory for its onboarding and neutral-document Harness members, built from the DocumentRenderingInputs.

name: LegacyRunnerOutputReader
definition: Port: reads, inside the legacy runner bridge's child, the folder the frozen runner generator wrote, as one tree of bytes naming each entry it cannot read; the file-system implementer serves it.

name: HostSurfaceReader
definition: Port: reads the files a harness authors for its own tree (harness/<h>/**).

name: NativeCommandName
definition: A host's native name for one command, which is also its folder: one portable path segment.

name: CommandFilePath
definition: Where a file sits inside its native command's folder: a portable relative path that cannot climb out.

name: EntryShortcut
definition: One of the door's fixed entry shortcuts, aidlc-init or aidlc-compose.

name: CommandSubject
definition: What a native command is rendered for: a stage, a scope, or an entry shortcut of the orchestrator skill.

name: NativeCommandFile
definition: One file of a native command: its command name, its place in the command's folder, its content and mode.

name: CommandReading
definition: What the command source gives for a subject: the rendered files, or that it declines to render one.

name: CommandSource
definition: Port: reads the native command files for a subject.

name: CommandPlacement
definition: Port: the host's project path for a native command file.

name: ProjectMethodRequest
definition: The method, its sources and the neutral surface to project for one harness.

name: ProjectMethodForHarness
definition: Use case: projects a Method into one harness's files.

name: RuntimeEntryPoint
definition: A runtime composition root the payload bundles.

name: PayloadFileOrigin
definition: Whether a payload file was projected, bundled runtime, the version stamp or the descriptor.

name: PayloadFile
definition: One shipped file with its hash and origin.

name: RetiredFile
definition: A file an earlier release shipped and this one does not, with its shipped hashes.

name: DistributionDescriptor
definition: A payload's host identity, layout and release history.

name: Payload
definition: One installable distribution: version, channel, descriptor and files.

name: ArchiveFormat
definition: tar.gz or zip.

name: ReleaseArtifact
definition: A built release archive: version, channel, distributions, digest and entries.

name: PackagingRefusal
definition: Why a payload or release cannot be built.

name: ToolBundler
definition: Port: bundles runtime entry points for a channel.

name: ArtifactWriter
definition: Port: writes payloads into a release archive.

name: ContentHasher
definition: Port: hashes file content.

name: PackagePayloadRequest
definition: The projection, channel, version and runtime entries to package.

name: PackagePayload
definition: Use case: turns a Projection into a Payload.

name: BuildReleaseArtifact
definition: Use case: refuses mixed versions or duplicate payloads, then writes the archive.

name: InstalledFile
definition: A file AI-DLC wrote into the project and the hash it wrote.

name: EntryHashes
definition: Entries AI-DLC owns inside a shared file, by key, with the hash it wrote.

name: RootContribution
definition: AI-DLC's share of one root integration, as written.

name: McpChoice
definition: Whether the install ships the default MCP servers.

name: OwnershipRecord
definition: What one install wrote: version, distribution, MCP choice, coverage, files, file entries, root shares, and whether the status line was kept.

name: InstallMode
definition: Fresh install, refresh (refusing or overwriting edited files) or removal.

name: FileChange
definition: What an update changes: content, the executable bit, or both.

name: ManagedFileDecision
definition: What happens to one file: create, update, unchanged, preserve or retire.

name: RootIntegrationDecision
definition: What happens to one root file, with its prior state and next content.

name: ConflictCause
definition: Why planning cannot change a path: an edit, an unowned edit, not a file, a missing sibling block, malformed content, a sibling of another release, or an unowned whole file.

name: InstallConflict
definition: One path planning cannot change, and why.

name: InstallNote
definition: One line the person reads about the plan.

name: ReadyInstallPlan
definition: A plan with no conflicts; its operations and record after are derived from its decisions.

name: BlockedInstallPlan
definition: A plan with at least one conflict; nothing is applied, as upstream config refuses.

name: SiblingBlock
definition: Another installed distribution's shipped copy of a shared block, or that it is missing.

name: InstallPlan
definition: The immutable aggregate: ready or blocked.

name: InstalledDistribution
definition: A distribution installed in this project: its version and descriptor.

name: CallingHarness
definition: Which installed distribution this command runs for: sole, marked by host shell, guessed, or none.

name: InstallRefusal
definition: Why an install or refresh cannot go ahead, with what to do.

name: ProjectFileState
definition: What is at a project path now: absent, file, link or directory.

name: ExpectedState
definition: What a file operation expects to find before it acts.

name: FileOperation
definition: One write, remove or link, with the state it expects first.

name: ProjectFiles
definition: Port: reads project file state.

name: OwnershipStore
definition: Port: reads the OwnershipRecord, parsing it with Zod.

name: Transaction
definition: Port: applies file operations and the record write all-or-nothing.

name: InstalledDistributions
definition: Port: lists distributions installed in the project.

name: SiblingRootBlocks
definition: Port: reads every other installed distribution's shipped block for one shared root integration.

name: PayloadSource
definition: Port: fetches the payload to install.

name: PlanInstallRequest
definition: Payload and mode to plan.

name: PlanInstall
definition: Use case: compares a payload with the project and its record into an InstallPlan.

name: ApplyInstallPlan
definition: Use case: applies a ready plan through the Transaction or refuses.

name: ResolveCallingHarness
definition: Use case: works out the CallingHarness.

name: IntentId
definition: Identity of one piece of work (an intent) and its WorkflowRecord.

name: IntentSlug
definition: The readable label of an intent.

name: SpaceName
definition: A named space of intents and team memory under aidlc/.

name: SessionId
definition: Identity of one host chat.

name: UnitName
definition: Identity of a Unit of work; a safe path component.

name: CheckoutId
definition: Identity of a git checkout that can hold Units.

name: PlanFingerprint
definition: The fingerprint of an approved plan; binds an approval to what was approved.

name: RecordVersion
definition: Optimistic version of a WorkflowRecord.

name: Unit
definition: A Unit of work in this intent, its kind and dependencies.

name: UnitDag
definition: The Units and the batches Construction walks.

name: UnitHolder
definition: Which checkout holds a Unit, by claim.

name: CheckpointKind
definition: Unit or skeleton checkpoint.

name: Checkpoint
definition: Where a finished Unit's stages are verified and approved together.

name: BlockingCheckSite
definition: Where a blocking check stands: a stage gate or a Unit checkpoint.

name: BlockingCheckOutcome
definition: Passed, failed, or overridden by the person.

name: BlockingCheck
definition: A blocking sensor's result at its site.

name: Gate
definition: A point where the person decides: stage gate, plan approval or checkpoint.

name: GateDecision
definition: Approve, request changes, skip, jump or stop.

name: HumanEvidenceSource
definition: How a human turn was observed: host hook or host transcript.

name: HumanEvidence
definition: An observed turn the person typed; a fact, separate from what Guard Policy makes it mean.

name: Approval
definition: A recorded gate decision with its plan fingerprint and the basis it holds on: the person's evidence, or the human-presence guard standing aside under its recorded lift.

name: ReviewAttempt
definition: One requested review of a stage's artifact.

name: ReviewFindingStatus
definition: Open, resolved, rejected or reopened.

name: ReviewFinding
definition: One reviewer finding.

name: ReviewReceipt
definition: A reviewer's verdict and findings for an attempt.

name: GuardId
definition: Identity of a guard; core's six are constants, others may be namespaced.

name: GuardLift
definition: How the person lifts a guard: switch it, override once, or locked where.

name: GuardRefusal
definition: One stop: the guard declaration, why, and the next step; its lift comes from the guard.

name: GuardSwitch
definition: The person switching a guard on or off, in their words.

name: StageProgress
definition: pending, in-progress, awaiting-approval, revising, completed or skipped.

name: StageState
definition: A stage's progress in this intent, per Unit when per-unit.

name: WorkflowStatus
definition: Running, parked, completed or archived.

name: WorkflowSettings
definition: This intent's depth, Guard Policy, ceremony switches and review override.

name: WorkflowRecord
definition: The aggregate: everything recorded about one intent.

name: TransitionCause
definition: Whether the engine or a person's decision moved the work.

name: Transition
definition: A recorded move: stage progress, park, resume, reopen or complete.

name: Reopen
definition: The Transition that takes finished work back to running when the person asks.

name: SessionBindingSource
definition: How a chat came to be on a piece of work.

name: SessionBinding
definition: Which space and intent a chat is on.

name: Session
definition: One chat on this clone, with its binding.

name: AuditEvent
definition: A sequenced audit entry.

name: HostEvent
definition: One host lifecycle event; each HookPoint has its own shape.

name: ArtifactDestination
definition: Where a stage's artifact is written for this run.

name: QuestionOption
definition: One option put to the person, in plain words.

name: Directive
definition: What the engine tells the conductor to do next.

name: ExecutionRefusal
definition: Why the engine cannot act: a guard, or the record.

name: RecordStore
definition: Port: loads and saves WorkflowRecords with optimistic versions.

name: AuditLog
definition: Port: appends audit entries in sequence and reads them back.

name: Clock
definition: Port: the current Timestamp.

name: HumanTurnHistory
definition: Port: the human turns the host recorded in a session since a time.

name: Sessions
definition: Port: the current chat.

name: UnitClaims
definition: Port: reads and makes Unit claims.

name: MethodProvider
definition: Port: the compiled Method this install runs.

name: HostConversation
definition: The host wording the engine needs, supplied by the host bundle at the composition root.

name: HostConversationSource
definition: Port: the HostConversation for this command.

name: NextStep
definition: Use case: the next Directive for an intent.

name: DecideAtGate
definition: Use case: records the person's decision at a gate, reading their turn from HumanTurnHistory.

name: ObserveHostEvent
definition: Use case: records a host event and answers with the verdict that event's point allows.

name: ReopenWorkflow
definition: Use case: reopens a finished workflow, reading the person's turn from HumanTurnHistory.

name: DecodeRefusal
definition: Why a host payload could not be decoded.

name: HostEventDecoder
definition: Port: one adapter per host turning its hook payload into a HostEvent; Execution owns it, each host implements it.

name: Platform
definition: The platform implementers the one composition root builds once: file system, process runner and YAML parser.

name: ConceptMembers
definition: What a host gives the build root for one rendered concept group: the authored files that group reads, and that group's renderer.

name: HostConceptMembers
definition: ConceptMembers with the host's identity, one row of a group's host table while the Harness is assembled group by group.

name: HostBuildMembers
definition: Everything one host gives the build root to assemble its Harness: its identity, the tokens it chooses, HostData, authored placements, command placement, its agent, skill, settings and document members, its onboarding fills, and, once it builds through the root, its HostDistributionReader.

name: HostDistributionReader
definition: A host's HostDistribution, built with the kernel's value constructors, so a path or hash it cannot accept is a refusal.

name: HostAgentMembers
definition: A host's members for the agents group: the authored agent files and its HostAgentRenderer.

name: HostSkillMembers
definition: A host's members for the skills group: the authored orchestrator files and its HostSkillRenderer.

name: HostAgentsRequest
definition: What the build root needs to render one host's agents: the captured host identity it looks the host's HostAgentMembers up by, the Method, the captured authored files and their preparer, the DistributionChannel, and the tier cap the build runs under.

name: ProjectAgents
definition: The PackageBuildRoot member that renders every Method agent and the conductor agent of one host from a HostAgentsRequest.

name: HostSkillsRequest
definition: What the build root needs to render one host's skills: the captured host identity it looks the host's HostSkillMembers up by, the built tree whose skill-table tool renders the tables, the Method, the captured authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, and the command source and placement the orchestrator skill's shortcuts render from.

name: ProjectSkills
definition: The PackageBuildRoot member that renders one host's orchestrator and session skills from a HostSkillsRequest; a host with no skill members gets no files.

name: HostSettingsRequest
definition: What the build root needs to render one host's settings and hook registrations: the captured host identity it looks the host's HostSettingsMembers up by, the Method, the captured authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, the DistributionChannel and the runtime entrypoints the install ships.

name: ProjectSettings
definition: The PackageBuildRoot member that renders one host's settings and hook registrations from a HostSettingsRequest; a host with no settings members gets no files.

name: HostRuntimeRequest
definition: What the build root needs to place the SharedRuntime for one host: the captured host identity, the Method the data files are rendered from, and the token bindings.

name: ProjectRuntime
definition: The PackageBuildRoot member that places the SharedRuntime, captured once per build, under one host's directory from a HostRuntimeRequest.

name: HostSurfaceMembers
definition: A host's members for its surface: its identity, the HostData it declares and its authored placements; the build reads the placements' sources.

name: HostSurfaceRequest
definition: What the build root needs to render one host's surface: the captured host identity it looks the host's HostSurfaceMembers up by, the captured authored files and their preparer, the token bindings, and the DistributionChannel.

name: ProjectHostSurface
definition: The PackageBuildRoot member that renders one host's harness.json, plugin-agent frontmatter and placed authored files from a HostSurfaceRequest; a host with no surface members gets no files.

name: HostDocumentMembers
definition: A host's members for the onboarding and documents group: the authored sources its onboarding fills come from and its HostDocumentRenderer.

name: HostSettingsMembers
definition: A host's members for the settings and hooks group: the authored settings and hook files and its HostSettingsRenderer.

name: BuildSources
definition: Where the build reads authored sources: the core folder and the plugins folder, by URL.

name: CoreBuildTarget
definition: The host a loaded core method is projected for: its name, its directory and where its memory sits.

name: CoreBuild
definition: The core method loaded once from authored sources, able to project its compiled files for any CoreBuildTarget.

name: CoreCommandRequest
definition: What the package script asks of the frozen command runners for one host: the loaded core, the project root it writes into, and the host directory and name.

name: HostSourcesRequest
definition: Which authored host files the package script reads for one host: its name and directory, the folder they live in, the files it copies and the ones that must exist.

name: CapturedHostSources
definition: One host's authored files, read once, with the host identity they were read for.

name: PackageBuildRoot
definition: The one composition root as the package script sees it until the script is only argv in and routes out: it loads the core and the plugins once, prepares the command runners and reads host sources, through the platform it was built with.

name: CreatePackageBuildRoot
definition: Builds the PackageBuildRoot from the platform implementers, the markdown outliner its caller builds over the frozen markdown interpreter, the build sources and the folder the runner frames are made in.

name: CompiledMethodFiles
definition: The compiled method a host ships, as text: its stage graph and its grid.

name: ExitStatus
definition: A CLI command's process exit status.

name: CommandRoute
definition: One CLI verb wired to one use case at a composition root.

name: ProjectPath
definition: A forward-slash path below the project root that cannot escape it.

name: SourcePath
definition: A forward-slash path below an authored source root (core or a plugin).

name: PathBase
definition: Which root a path is measured from: the project or an authored source.

name: RuleId
definition: Identity of one rule file in the method, such as team or phase-inception.

name: HookName
definition: Identity of one declared host hook.

name: ToolMatch
definition: Which tools a tool attachment listens to: every tool, or a non-empty list of ToolTargets.

name: HookDeclaration
definition: A core hook whose script is a method source, with its placement and one or more attachments. Host adapters render it from the attachment's point and targets, never from its name.

name: MethodSourcePath
definition: A path in the method's own layout, under the folder its MethodSourceKind fixes; the reader resolves it under the install's method source root or the project's aidlc folder.

name: MethodSourceRoot
definition: The project folder an install's method sources live under: the host's directory.

name: MethodSource
definition: One method source file with its path, owner and exact content; entities name it by path.

name: MethodSourceRefusal
definition: Why a raw value is not a valid method source path or root.

name: TextOffset
definition: A position in an authored body's text, in UTF-16 code units.

name: OutlineHeading
definition: One Markdown heading in a body, outside code: level, title, line start, content start.

name: AuthoredBody
definition: An authored Markdown body with its headings, the text overlays are placed into.

name: TieredModel
definition: An agent's model choice given as a neutral tier.

name: ModelChoice
definition: An agent's model: a neutral tier, or the host's default.

name: PersonaAdditions
definition: Plugin prose placed after the knowledge preflight or at the end of a persona.

name: CoreAgent
definition: A core agent; it always names a neutral tier.

name: PluginAgent
definition: A plugin's agent; it may leave its model to the host.

name: ScopeMembership
definition: The one record that a stage belongs to a scope, and who declared it.

name: FreeformDefaultClaim
definition: A scope's claim to be the freeform default, and who made it.

name: SectionAnchor
definition: An overlay anchor at the end of a named ## section, the same for a stage body and a persona.

name: StageAnchor
definition: Where in a stage body an overlay fragment lands.

name: PersonaAnchor
definition: Where in a persona an overlay fragment lands: after the preflight, at the end, or at the end of a named section.

name: RuleLevel
definition: The rule file a plugin's house rules land in: org, team or project.

name: PluginCommand
definition: A command a plugin names, the script it runs and a one-line description.

name: PluginTools
definition: A plugin's tool scripts, optional doctor check and commands.

name: CompiledMethod
definition: The shape of a compiled method: content, selection, graph and findings.

name: MethodSources
definition: What a method source read returns: core content, contributions, saved scopes, stage pins, every source file once keyed by path, and the plugins a build targets.

name: MethodSourceReader
definition: Port: reads the authored method sources once.

name: PluginBuildTarget
definition: A plugin a build packages, and the directory its authored files live in.

name: AuthoredTreeReader
definition: Port: the file reads the method loader needs from an authored tree: one file, one folder listing, or a selected tree.

name: FrontmatterParser
definition: Port: parses the YAML frontmatter of an authored source.

name: CapturedSourceFile
definition: One authored file read once: its path within its tree and its content.

name: CapturedMethodFiles
definition: The authored method files read once, by kind: stages, agents, scopes, sensors, rules and knowledge.

name: CapturedPluginFiles
definition: One plugin read once: its directory, its manifest, every file it ships, and its method files by kind.

name: AuthoredContent
definition: What decoding the core method files gives: the core content and every source file it came from.

name: ContributionReading
definition: What decoding one plugin gives: its contribution and every source file it came from.

name: MethodContentDecoder
definition: Port: decodes captured core method files into AuthoredContent, and a captured plugin into a ContributionReading.

name: AuthoredCoreMethod
definition: The core Method compiled from authored sources, with the authored core content and the source files it was compiled from.

name: AuthoredPluginBuild
definition: The Method compiled with the authored plugins, and the plugins a build targets.

name: MarkdownOutliner
definition: Port: outlines a Markdown body using AI-DLC's one Markdown interpreter.

name: Channel
definition: How a payload ships: copy (runtime as source) or native (runtime as binary).

name: DistributionLayout
definition: The install facts a host declares: root integrations and managed directories.

name: DistributionLayouts
definition: Port: the layout each host declares, read by Packaging.

name: NativeReleases
definition: Port: the native release each host declares, read by Packaging when it lays out the native channel.

name: NativeCommandRoutes
definition: Port: the dispatcher's trusted command prefix, namespace and delegate tools, a trusted command for a suffix, and the namespace invocations a native file names that do not resolve; the build root serves it from the dispatcher bridges.

name: PriorIntegrationShapes
definition: Hashes of earlier releases' content for one root integration.

name: ReleaseHistory
definition: The one owner of what earlier releases shipped: retired files and prior integration shapes.

name: ReleaseHistorySource
definition: Port: reads a distribution's release history.

name: ArchiveEntry
definition: A path inside a release archive.

name: BuildReleaseArtifactRequest
definition: The payloads and archive name and format to build.

name: PlannedContent
definition: Content a plan writes, with its hash.

name: WrittenShare
definition: What AI-DLC wrote into a root file: a block, the whole file, or entries with the keys it added.

name: JsonShape
definition: The JSON shape a key must have.

name: MalformedContent
definition: How a file's content is malformed: encoding, JSON, key shape or block markers.

name: RecordWrite
definition: The ownership record a transaction writes, with the state it expects first.

name: AuditSequence
definition: The position of an audit event in its log.

name: ExecutionIdentity
definition: Which Execution identity a raw value was meant to be.

name: ExecutionIdentityRefusal
definition: Why a raw value is not a valid Execution identity.

name: GuardIdRefusal
definition: Why a raw value is not a valid guard id.

name: GuardDeclaration
definition: One guard: what it protects and how it is lifted.

name: GuardInventory
definition: Every declared guard, derived from declarations.

name: ToolRequest
definition: A tool call the host reported: its name, the ToolTarget the host classified it as (or unclassified) and its subject.

name: AuditFact
definition: What an audit event records: a transition, gate decision, guard event, review, binding or host event.

name: AuditEntry
definition: An audit fact with its intent, session, time and cause, before it is sequenced.

name: HostResponse
definition: What a host's hook call gets back: output and a HostExitStatus.

name: StagePin
definition: A stage number an earlier compile pinned, kept so numbers stay stable.

name: SavedScope
definition: A scope the person saved from an approved composed plan, with its stages.

name: TemplateToken
definition: A token authored text may contain, which Projection binds per harness.

name: TokenBindings
definition: A harness's value for each template token, or none.

name: RecordCoverage
definition: Whether an ownership record lists shipped files only, or may still list project files from an older release.

name: FileEntries
definition: The JSON entries AI-DLC owns in one managed file, with their hashes.

name: HostResponseEncoder
definition: Port: encodes an ObservedHostEvent into the host's response format; Execution owns it, each host implements it.

name: HostEventAt
definition: The host event shape at one HookPoint.

name: VerdictFor
definition: The answers the engine may give at one HookPoint: allow, add context, block with a GuardRefusal, or show status.

name: ObservedHostEvent
definition: A host event paired with a verdict its point allows, handed to the host's response encoder.

name: HostIdentity
definition: Which distribution a host is and the project folder it owns, declared once by its host bundle.

name: HostedHarness
definition: A Harness with the host identity it renders for.

name: HostBoundToken
definition: A template token a host binds; HARNESS_DIR is bound by Projection from the host's directory.

name: HostTokenBindings
definition: A host's value, or null, for every HostBoundToken.

name: HostTokenChoices
definition: The tokens a host chooses itself: how its skill is invoked and its option letters.

name: ChannelTokens
definition: The tokens a DistributionChannel decides: the invoke command, the tool prefix and the trusted namespace.

name: AgentRenderingInputs
definition: What every host's agent renderer gets from the build root: the captured host identity, the DistributionChannel it renders for, the authored agent files and their preparer, the AgentModelPolicy, and the shipped format documents a dispatched agent's shared knowledge leaves out.

name: AgentModelPolicy
definition: Port: the model a host pins for one tiered agent, or none when the host's own default applies; refused for a host the model policy does not know.

name: DelegateShellPolicy
definition: Port: the shell commands a host denies each delegated agent, and the risky shell forms it asks about, as the runtime guards and dispatcher admit them; the delegate shell bridge serves it until those owners move into src.

name: HostDataInputs
definition: What a host's HostDataRenderer gets from Projection: the DelegateShellPolicy for the host's directory.

name: HostDataRenderer
definition: Produces a host's HostData from its HostDataInputs; a host whose facts are all static ignores the inputs.

name: HostAgentRenderer
definition: One host's factory for its agent and conductor-agent Harness members, built from the AgentRenderingInputs.

name: ToolHookPoint
definition: A HookPoint around a tool call: before-tool or after-tool.

name: LifecycleHookPoint
definition: A HookPoint that is not around a tool call.

name: MethodSourceKind
definition: Which kind of method source a file is; each kind has one fixed folder. An overlay is a plugin contribution under contributions/, located by its owning plugin.

name: MethodSourceLocation
definition: Which method source file a fact is about: its owner and MethodSourcePath, the one key entities, bytes and refusals share.

name: AuthoredTree
definition: Which authored source root a path is read below: core or plugins.

name: AuthoredTreeLocation
definition: A path below an authored source root, as read, before it is known to be a method source or a plugin: empty for the root itself, ending in a slash for a folder.

name: MethodFileLocation
definition: Which file a method refusal is about: a method source, a plugin manifest, or the stage pins.

name: FileMode
definition: Whether a file is written as a regular file or an executable.

name: IntegrationLifecycle
definition: Whether a root integration is live in this release or being retired.

name: ToolTarget
definition: A host-neutral kind of tool call the workflow cares about: file read, file write, file search, shell, subagent dispatch, task list update, or a question to the person. Each host adapter maps it to its own tool matchers.

name: LifecycleAttachment
definition: A hook attached at a lifecycle point.

name: ToolAttachment
definition: A hook attached before or after a tool call, for the tools its ToolMatch names.

name: HookAttachment
definition: One place a hook runs: a lifecycle attachment or a tool attachment.

name: HookPlacement
definition: Whether a hook gets its own host entry or runs inside a named group of hooks, in declaration order.

name: HookAudience
definition: Which agents an attachment applies to: every agent, or the stage reviewers the Method's ReviewPolicy names. Definition selects; a host adapter places the registration.

name: HostExitStatus
definition: The exit status a host reads from a hook call: allow, error or block.

name: ApprovalBasis
definition: Why an approval holds: the person's HumanEvidence, or the GuardSwitch that lowered the human-presence guard. It never holds on a guess.
